_: Contests to aim the next film, song or book at, researched on 6 October 2026: everything Higgsfield runs or co-runs first, then the five AI video platforms whose contests come closest, then independent AI festivals, music, quick-turn, traditional festivals and writing prizes. Free or low-cost entry is marked; so is any rule that limits AI-made work.
platforms_note: After Higgsfield, these five run the contests that come closest: AI video tools with regular film prizes. Ranked by how well Matter of Light and the next episode fit — any-tool contests above single-tool ones, cash and screenings above credits. Most require their own tool for most of the film, so a Higgsfield cut usually can't be entered as it is; each card says what it would take.

platforms.name: Runway
platforms.why: Its annual AI Festival is the major platform contest open to films made with any tool, so Matter of Light fits the 3–15 minute film track as it is. Free entry; the 2026 prizes were $135k+ with a $50k Grand Prix and a Lincoln Center screening. The 2026 call closed on 27 April and the 2027 call isn't out yet. Gen:48, a 48-hour challenge for a 1–4 minute film, runs about twice a year.

platforms.name: ByteDance — Dreamina, Seedance, CapCut
platforms.why: Runs the largest open prize, the $1M AI Film Award 2027 (deadline 20 November 2026; 5–7 minutes, at least 70% Seedance, made new for the award), plus $10k–$80k challenges every few weeks. Everything needs its own tools. Higgsfield offers Seedance models, so ask the organizers whether Seedance shots made inside Higgsfield count.

platforms.name: PixVerse
platforms.why: PixLight 2026: $300k in prizes, $100k top, free, deadline 31 October 2026. Its Worlds Beyond track (sci-fi and fantasy) takes a 3–20 minute pilot, which is what Darkness is. The film must be made mainly in PixVerse, though other footage can be mixed in.

platforms.name: Kling AI
platforms.why: Recurring global contests with cash and screenings at real festivals: NextGen 2025 ($42k, Tokyo International Film Festival and MIPCOM) ran September–October 2025; the 4K Short Film contest ($25k, Seoul) ran in the first half of 2026. Each needs a large Kling share. No 2026 NextGen call found yet; the pattern says watch for one.

platforms.name: Chroma Awards (ElevenLabs, Freepik, Dreamina and others)
platforms.why: Season 2 is free, with $175k+ in cash and $1M+ in credits, and has Film and Music Video categories, which suits the Suno soundtracks. Pre-registration is open; the deadline isn't announced (reported to run to the end of 2026). Whether tools outside the sponsors are allowed is unclear.

items.name: Higgsfield Global Film Festival 2026
items.dates_note: Entries closed (user already entered). Opened Aug 10, 2026; deadline moved from Sep 3 to Sep 14, 11:59 PM UTC (a few write-ups say Sep 15 or 16). The schedule moved again: snippets of hollywood.ai and creatorstoolbox (updated around Oct 5, 2026) say shortlist plus Audience Choice voting on Oct 8, 2026, jury review Oct 9-14, winners in the last week of October 2026. The jury and Higgsfield's team rank the same shortlist without seeing vote counts. The higgsfield.ai pages could not be loaded from this container.
items.entry_fee: free (any registered Higgsfield account; most sources say no paid plan is needed, one write-up says an active subscription is)
items.requirements: 18+, solo or a team of up to 4 (the Team Leader is paid). Minimum 3 min, 3-5 min recommended, any genre. Every AI image and video frame generated inside Higgsfield Cinema Studio (outside Sora, Runway, Veo or Kling shots disqualify), with production history kept in a dedicated Cinema Studio project. Music, voice and SFX AI-generated and uploaded to the project. No real person's face or voice as input. English subtitles or voice-over. MP4/MOV up to 4K. Higgsfield watermark and packshot. A public post of the same video on Instagram, YouTube, X or Reddit, viewable while logged out. Prompts are made public.
items.prize: $1,000,000 across 14 winners: 1st $500,000; 2nd $200,000; 3rd $100,000; Audience Choice $100,000; 10 Honorable Mentions at $10,000. Jury includes Edwin Catmull and Phedon Papamichael.
items.fit: Already entered with 'Matter of Light'. The one remaining action is the $100k Audience Choice track: if the film makes the Oct 8 shortlist, rally votes right away and keep the public post live.

items.fit: Closed, but it is the clearest template for Higgsfield's large film contests (short cinematic scene, Cinema Studio, judges who rewarded story and directorial intent). A battle beat from your fantasy world would have fit well.

items.dates_note: Opened Jul 27, 2026, 9:00 AM ET; closed Aug 24, 2026, 11:59 PM ET; winners revealed on stage at Brandweek 2026 in Atlanta on Sep 16. 1st: AI-R Studio (Mexico), 'Don't Kill the AI Stars'. 3rd: AI STUDIO 48 (Seoul). Judges: Zoe Ruderman (ADWEEK), AJ Coyne (Monzo), Elav Horwitz (WPP), Michael Ventura, Linda Bethea. Tied to Brandweek, so it may come back in 2027.

A 30-60s ad for a real brand against the team's own brief (no supplied product or assets). Up to 49% of the spot may be live action. Judged equally on idea, brand storytelling and effectiveness, craft, and realism.

items.fit: Poor fit: it needs a professional agency or brand team and a business plan, the prizes are credits only, and the format is a brand ad rather than narrative fantasy.

items.dates_note: Submissions Jul 8 - Jul 22, 2026, 8:00 AM PT; judging Jul 22-29. Newly published on or after the open date, deployed, original IP. Post it on IG, TikTok, YouTube or X with a link and #HiggsfieldApp. Judged on usage 40%, creativity 30%, social engagement 15%, in-app gallery engagement 15%.
items.fit: Weak fit for a filmmaker. Usage-weighted judging favours viral utility apps, though a 'Matter of Light' world or character app could double as promotion.

items.prize: Unknown (round 1 was $100,000)
items.fit: Low priority; check the page in 2 minutes, and enter only if a film-companion app is cheap to build.

items.dates_note: Ran Nov 4, 2025, 11:00 AM PT to Nov 30, 2025, 11:59 PM PT. No winner list was found. A November slot could repeat in 2026, but that is my inference.

items.fit: Good fit if you recruit 1-3 collaborators. 'Best Team Story' and 'Best Asset Management' reward exactly the organised element and shot-board pipeline you already have.

items.name: Higgsfield Max Challenge (MiniMax x Higgsfield $20K Click-to-Video Challenge)
items.dates_note: Launched early Aug 2025 as a two-week challenge with free MiniMax Hailuo generations. The original Aug 10, 2025 deadline was extended to Aug 17, 2025, 11:59 PM PST. One snippet describes an August Higgsfield x MiniMax contest for 'short music videos'; this appears to be the same event.

items.prize: $10K (unclear whether that is the pool or the top prize)

items.requirements: Unknown (an X post challenge)

items.fit: Small-stakes credits, worth watching @higgsfield_ai for: a 1-hour entry from existing footage can earn a month of generation for Episode 2.

items.dates_note: A new theme every week, posted in #community-events with format rules, a deadline and a submission form. The best work is featured on community streams and in #stream-spotlight.

items.prize: Usually Higgsfield credits plus a stream feature

items.prize: A credit reward for each daily winner

items.name: Higgsfield Discord Monthly Awards
items.dates_note: Monthly nominations in #monthly-awards recognise the month's most active and standout community members. Promo codes are also handed out during events.
items.requirements: Active Discord participation
items.prize: Roles and credits
items.fit: A by-product of the weekly and daily challenges, worth it only for visibility with the team.

items.name: Higgsfield Creator Partnership Program (CPP / ambassadors)
items.dates_note: Rolling applications. Every application is reviewed by a person and answered by email. Ambassador enquiries go to marketing@higgsfield.ai. A 2025 SpotLight grand prize included an 'Ambassador contract'.
items.requirements: Application form (platforms, total audience, country, link to recent work). No follower minimum. Partners tag or mention Higgsfield when its tools are used.
items.prize: A full Higgsfield plan renewed monthly, extra credits for bigger projects, early model access, a direct line to the team, a partner community and affiliate earnings (no cash prize)
items.fit: Strong fit: a festival entry plus an Episode 2 board is a credible application, and a free monthly plan with project credits directly funds Episode 2.

items.name: Higgsfield Earn (paid brand campaigns for AI creators)
items.dates_note: Launched around Jan 23, 2026 as a $100,000 weekly pool aimed at AI influencers. Higgsfield says it has paid out over $1M to 10,000+ verified creators at a 90% approval rate (under $100 per creator on average).
items.requirements: Connect an Instagram, YouTube or X account (verification code in bio). Pick a campaign, download its assets and post an approved video. KYC payout partner. No follower floor. Pay depends on channel size, engagement, geography and campaign type.
items.prize: Guaranteed per-approved-video payout plus 24-hour and day-7 bonuses (up to a 130% boost); capped at $1,000 on day one and $2,500 lifetime per video
items.fit: Low fit: branded promo clips, not cinema. Useful only as side income if you run a social account.

items.name: Higgsfield Affiliate Program
items.dates_note: An X post says it is 'now open to everyone'. An independent GitHub explainer (last reviewed Sep 22, 2026, read today) says it sits inside the Creator Partnership Program and that no rate is published, which contradicts the 25% figure on Higgsfield's blog and X post.
items.requirements: Apply for a personal affiliate link; anyone with an audience
items.prize: Up to 25% cash revenue share on qualifying subscriptions, renewals and upgrades for 12 months (tiered); referred users get up to 50% off within 3 hours of clicking
items.fit: Passive. Add the link to the film's public post and description; it costs nothing.

items.name: Seedance 2.0 Unlimited referral program
items.dates_note: Ended Jul 16, 2026. Similar unlimited-model promotions recur (e.g. '30-Day Seedance Unlimited', '33 Days of Unlimited Seedance 2.5' blog posts).

items.prize: Unlimited Seedance 2.0: 3 days for 1 friend, 5 days for 2, 7 days for 3; friends got up to 60% off
items.fit: Closed. Watch for repeats: a week of unlimited generation is ideal for rendering the 26-shot Episode 2 board.

Viewers vote on which pilots become full series. Higgsfield 'plans to open submissions' for creators to pitch their own pilots; no date was found. Its blog says getting onto Original Series 'starts with Higgsfield contests', so GFF shortlisting could feed into it. It also includes an AI Likeness Licensing framework for influencers.

items.prize: Funding and promotion for full-scale production, distribution on Higgsfield Originals and social (no fixed cash amount published)
items.fit: Best strategic fit: an episodic fantasy with Episode 1 made and a 26-shot Episode 2 board is exactly what a crowd-greenlit series slot wants. Pitch as soon as submissions open.

items.prize: 2026 benchmark: $135k+ total; Film Grand Prix $50,000 + 1M Runway credits; Gold $15,000 + 500k credits; other-track Grand Prix $10,000 + 500k credits.

items.dates_note: 1st edition Oct 2023; 2nd Feb 3-5, 2024; 3rd Sept 2024; a 4th in 2025; 5th 'Aleph Edition' Aug 2025. items.prize: Grand Prix $5,000 + 1M Runway credits (ARV $10k) + 1 yr Epidemic Sound Commercial; People's Choice same; 2nd-5th 500k credits each; Grand Prix films screen at AIF.

items.dates_note: Announced Sept 2024 with $5M to fund up to 100 films using AI video. Whether it still takes applications in 2026 couldn't be confirmed.
items.requirements: Film projects using AI-generated video; selection by Runway.
items.prize: Production funding: $5M earmarked to fund up to 100 films (per-project amounts not confirmed).
items.fit: A possible funding route for the 26-shot Episode 2 if the program still accepts pitches.

items.organizer: ByteDance (BytePlus / Dreamina Seedance) with 1 Billion Followers Summit (Dubai) and TikTok

Higgsfield offers Seedance models, so ask the organizers whether Seedance shots generated inside Higgsfield count toward the 70%.

items.dates_note: Weekly cycles Monday-Sunday UTC; submit links before Sunday 23:59 UTC; cash reviewed weekly, paid monthly.

items.prize: Weekly Platform Engagement Award $1,750 across 15 slots; PixVerse Creative Awards $1,000 (10 x $100).
items.fit: Small but steady cash. Best used to get PixVerse Canvas practice while preparing a PixLight entry.

items.name: PixVerse V5 4-Day Free Challenge (and earlier PixVerse contests)
items.dates_note: V5 challenge announced Aug 28, 2025 ($5,000). Also an AI video creation contest with a $2,000 grand prize (categories Most Viral, Best Anime, Best Ad, Best Realism) and a Story Extension Challenge; exact dates not confirmed.
items.requirements: Videos made with PixVerse models.
items.prize: Up to $5,000 total (V5 challenge); $2,000 grand prize (creation contest).
items.fit: Shows that PixVerse runs small model-launch challenges several times a year alongside the big annual PixLight.

items.name: Kling AI NextGen Creative Contest (global)
items.dates_note: Submissions Sept 12 - Oct 6, 2025 (UTC+8); judging Oct 7-17; winners by Oct 18, 2025; screenings at MIPCOM Cannes and Tokyo International Film Festival, awards ceremony Tokyo Oct 29, 2025. 4,600+ entries from 122 countries. No 2026 global NextGen call was found as of Oct 6, 2026.
items.requirements: At least 50% AI-generated with a significant portion made in Kling AI; English (or English-dubbed version); original; content rules incl. Chinese platform content policies.
items.prize: $42,000 cash + 1.25M Kling credits; festival screenings and attendance; media coverage.
items.fit: Big-festival exposure (TIFF, MIPCOM) for cinematic shorts, but it needs a substantial Kling portion and is annual around Sept-Oct, so check the activity zone.

items.name: Kling AI 4K Short Film Creative Contest (global)
items.dates_note: Launched around late April 2026 alongside native 4K output; ran through the first half of 2026; about 9,000 creators entered; 1 Gold (Malaysia) and 3 Silver; screening/ceremony at Seoul Film Center by early July 2026. Exact deadline not found.
items.requirements: High-quality native-4K short film, any theme, made with Kling AI (4K output).
items.prize: $25,000 + 700,000 Kling credits pool; in-person Seoul screening invitation.
items.fit: 'Any theme' plus 4K suits a high-polish fantasy short, but shots would need to be regenerated in Kling.

items.name: Kling NEXTGEN 2026 Korea University Creative Challenge / China Campus AIGC Competition
items.dates_note: Held in H1 2026; awarded around July 2026.
items.requirements: University students in Korea / China; Kling AI.
items.prize: Not confirmed.
items.fit: Student-only, so probably not eligible.

items.name: Kling AI Activity Zone - rolling in-app creative challenges
items.dates_note: Kling's hub for contests and campaigns; the current list couldn't be read (domain blocked).
items.requirements: Kling-generated content.
items.prize: Varies (mostly credits; occasional cash).
items.fit: Check this page by hand for a 2026 NextGen-style global contest, which the Sept-Oct pattern suggests could appear.

items.name: Chroma Awards Season 2 - AI Film, Music Video & Games
items.organizer: ElevenLabs (presented with Google Cloud, Freepik, fal, Dreamina, CapCut)
items.dates_note: Aggregators describe Season 2 as running June 1 - Dec 31, 2026, with pre-registration open and the deadline still to be announced.
items.requirements: Divisions: Film, Music Video, Games; about 25 categories. Tool rules for S2 not confirmed (S1 was sponsor-driven, with partner-tool awards).
items.prize: $175,000+ cash plus $1M+ in tool credits across categories (per aggregators).
items.fit: Strong two-way fit: a fantasy short in Film and a Suno-scored piece in Music Video, both free. Confirm on chromaawards.com whether Higgsfield/Suno work qualifies.

items.name: Chroma Awards Season 1 (2025)
items.organizer: ElevenLabs (presented with FAL, Freepik, Dreamina, CapCut; run via Devpost)
items.dates_note: Opened Sept 2025; deadline Nov 3, 2025, 11:45 PM PT; later cinema screenings incl. London (dates not confirmed).
items.requirements: AI film, music video or game entries via Devpost.
items.prize: $176,500 in total prizes.
items.fit: Shows the yearly autumn-deadline pattern.

items.name: Global AI Film Award (1 Billion Followers Summit 2026) - powered by Google Gemini
items.organizer: Google (Gemini / Veo / Flow) with 1 Billion Followers Summit
items.dates_note: Deadline Nov 20, extended to Dec 5, 2025; finalists Jan 8, 2026; winner Zoubeir ElJlassi announced Jan 11, 2026. For 2027 the award moved to Seedance/BytePlus (see aifilmaward-2027-seedance).
items.entry_fee: Free (not explicitly stated in the snippets)
items.requirements: 7-10 min; at least 70% generated with Google AI (Gemini, Veo, Imagen, Flow, or third-party tools built on Gemini); English subtitles; set themes.
items.fit: Google isn't running it again, so it only matters as precedent.

items.name: Future Vision XPRIZE ($3.5M) - with Google and Range Media Partners
items.organizer: XPRIZE with Google (and Range Media Partners)
items.dates_note: Launched Mar 9, 2026; closed Aug 15, 2026; finalists and winners at an LA event Sept 25, 2026.
items.requirements: 3-min sci-fi trailer, treatment up to 12 pages and a 2-page synopsis depicting an optimistic tech-enabled future; live action, animation, AI or hybrid.
items.prize: Grand Prize $2.5M feature production funding + $100,000 cash; 4 finalists $100,000; Top 10 $10,000.
items.fit: Any tool was allowed but it is closed. If it repeats, the optimistic-future brief is a stretch for fantasy work.

items.name: The Luma Dream Brief ($1M Cannes Lions competition)
items.dates_note: Feb 2 - Mar 22, 2026; about 400 entries; 21 featured finalists announced Apr 9 and entered into Cannes Lions (June 2026). Whether any finalist won the $1M Gold Lion couldn't be confirmed. A 2027 edition hasn't been announced.
items.entry_fee: Free to enter (payment may be needed to use Luma tools)
items.requirements: Ad based on a 'best unmade idea' that advertises or promotes Luma AI; at least 70% generated with Luma; videos 10 s minimum; 18-person jury.
items.prize: $1,000,000 only if the sponsored entry wins a Cannes Lions Gold Lion; finalists receive paid media support.
items.fit: Poor fit: it's an ad brief promoting Luma and the prize depends on a Cannes Gold Lion.

items.name: Clio Awards AI Challenge - Powered by Dream Machine
items.organizer: Luma AI with The Clio Awards
items.dates_note: Opened Sept 11, 2025; deadline Oct 6, 2025, 11:59 PM ET; finalists on stage at the Clio Creative Summit NYC, Oct 20, 2025.
items.requirements: Junior to mid-level creatives and recent grads; 10-s vertical 9:16 ad made with Dream Machine.
items.prize: 3 finalists: 6-month Dream Machine Unlimited ($569.94 value) + Clio Summit stage slot.
items.fit: Ad format and an experience limit, so it's a poor fit.

items.name: Luma Ray2 Awards
items.dates_note: Model-launch promo; submissions due Jan 22, 2025; winners Jan 27, 2025.
items.requirements: Post Ray2 content on social media; most views on one platform wins.
items.prize: $5,000 most-viewed + $3,000 raffle.
items.fit: A viral-views promo, so not relevant.

items.name: WSXA x Hailuo AI Film Competition
items.dates_note: Jul 25 - Sept 25, 2025; winners Oct 22, 2025; finalist screening WSXA Amsterdam Oct 2025, select winners at ARFF Berlin Nov 2025.
items.requirements: Theme: sustainable filmmaking; categories incl. Best AI Narrative and Best MiniMax Audio Dubbing; Hailuo AI / MiniMax Audio (7-day free trial provided).
items.prize: EUR 2,500 shared equally among 5 winners.
items.fit: Small prize but brings festival screenings. Hailuo mostly sponsors partner festivals rather than running its own.

items.name: MiniMax (Hailuo AI) Best AI Microfilm Award - Inspiring Asia 2025
items.organizer: MiniMax (Hailuo AI) with Inspiring Asia Micro Film Festival
items.dates_note: Deadline Sept 8, 2025.
items.requirements: Microfilm on youth mental health; Hailuo AI.
items.prize: $10,000 Best AI Microfilm Award.
items.fit: The theme doesn't match fantasy work.

items.name: 'What if...?' Hailuo AI x Freepik Video Competition
items.requirements: Alternate-timeline / parallel-universe story, at least 30 s, made with Hailuo AI and Freepik assets.
items.prize: 30 finalists: 1-month Hailuo premium (no cash found).
items.fit: A speculative-fiction theme, but the prize is small. This is the only Freepik-branded contest found.

items.name: WAIFF 2026 (Cannes) - MiniMax Hailuo global partner / Chinese Special Track
items.organizer: MiniMax (Hailuo AI) as partner of World AI Film Festival
items.dates_note: WAIFF 2026 held in Cannes around May 2026; Hailuo co-initiated the Chinese Special Track. WAIFF itself is run by a third party.
items.requirements: Per WAIFF rules.
items.prize: Not confirmed.
items.fit: Belongs in the festival tier; listed only as a Hailuo partnership.

items.name: Shortest AI Film Competition - Forward Festival Berlin x LTX Studio
items.dates_note: Opened June 9, 2026; deadline extended to June 28; notification July 17; screening at Forward Festival Berlin Aug 27-28, 2026. Seems to be annual.
items.requirements: 10-60 s film created with LTX Studio (post/editing allowed); English subtitles if needed; mp4 under 1GB.
items.prize: $10k total: 1st $3,000 + travel to Berlin + 1-yr LTX Pro; 2nd $1,500; 3rd $1,000; audience $250.
items.fit: A 60-second teaser of 'Matter of Light' would suit it if remade in LTX. Watch for the 2027 edition around June.

items.name: Vidu in-app creative challenges (#ViduQ2OnStage, #YesVidu, Q3R2V Full Cast, Image2 x Q3)
items.dates_note: #ViduQ2OnStage Oct 21 - Nov 3, 2025; #YesVidu Jan 30 - Feb 15, 2026; Q3R2V Full Cast Apr 13-26, 2026; Image2 x Q3 Global Creative Challenge May 12 - Jun 1 (2026 assumed). Nothing open was confirmed for Oct 2026.
items.requirements: Made with the named Vidu model/feature; submitted via form/social.
items.prize: Credits plus modest cash (amounts not confirmed).
items.fit: Low stakes and frequent, so it's optional.

items.name: Grok Imagine x Homer's Odyssey Contest
items.dates_note: Aug 17-31, 2026; winners announced Sept 2026 (GP Nem Perez).
items.requirements: US residents 18+ only; 3-5 min scene from Homer's Odyssey made with Grok Imagine, with at least 1 min of English dialogue; ranked by Premium impressions, then judged.
items.fit: Mythic-fantasy subject matter, but it's US-only and impression-ranked. Watch for a follow-up.

items.name: Artlist $250K Seedance 2.5 Challenge
items.dates_note: Aug 17-31, 2026; 12 winners announced.
items.requirements: At least 30 s, generated with Seedance 2.5 on Artlist; challenge badge visible throughout; posted publicly on social.
items.prize: $250,000 pool; up to 25 creators, up to $10,000 each.
items.fit: A quick social challenge. Shows how many Seedance-backed contests are running.

items.name: Project Odyssey AI Film Competition (Seasons 1-3)
items.dates_note: Season 1 (2024) and Season 2 (late 2024 - 2025) drew 6,000+ films. Season 3 was planned for Oct-Nov 2025 with a Las Vegas gala, then paused Aug 26, 2025. No restart was found.
items.requirements: Multi-category AI films; sponsor-tool categories.
items.prize: Cash plus sponsor prizes (S3 amounts not announced).
items.fit: On hold. Worth checking again if Season 3 restarts.

items.name: Moonvalley Marey contest (with Form Studios Virtual Film Challenge)
items.dates_note: Aug 1-31, 2025, as reported in a snippet. Details are thin and it may be a partner challenge rather than a Moonvalley-run contest.
items.requirements: Not confirmed (virtual-production tools allowed).
items.prize: Not confirmed.
items.fit: Too little information to act on.

items.name: Reply AI Film Festival
items.dates_note: 2026 edition (3rd, theme 'Imaginatio Nova') closed 1 Jun 2026; finalists screened at a Venice event in Sept 2026; 2,181 entries. The 2026 call was announced in March 2026. No 2027 call found yet.
items.entry_fee: Not stated in search snippets (entries go through the Reply Challenges platform, aiff.reply.com)
items.requirements: Age 18+ on the deadline; 1-40 min; AI tools must be used in the creation process (not only generative AI); you must explain how AI was used.
items.prize: Reward pool of EUR 30,000+; invitation to the Venice premiere event; special awards (AI for Good Award with ITU, Reply AI Studios Grand Prix). In 2026 the first 400 entrants also got FLORA credits.
items.fit: A 6-minute cinematic fantasy short fits the 1-40 min window, and the Venice showcase is one of the most prestigious AI-film stages; aim Episode 2 at the 2027 call.

items.name: Chroma Awards (formerly Project Odyssey)
items.organizer: Chroma Awards, incubated and presented by ElevenLabs with Google Cloud, FAL, Freepik, Dreamina and CapCut; run on Devpost
items.dates_note: The snippets disagree. Devpost lists Season 2 submissions as Aug 31-Nov 18, 2025, with the ceremony on Dec 21, 2025. melies.co lists 'Season 2' as running Jun 1-Dec 31, 2026. I could not confirm whether a season is open today, so check chromaawards.com.
items.requirements: Film, Music Video and Games divisions; register on Devpost; sponsor tool trials are provided.
items.prize: Season 2: $191,500 cash across categories, plus $1M+ in sponsor tool credits (Season 1 had 6,500+ entries).
items.fit: Free and high-profile, with both a Film track and a Music Video track: enter the short and a Suno soundtrack video.

items.name: AI International Film Festival
items.organizer: AI International Film Festival (aifilmfest.org; calls itself 'The Original Independent AI Film Festival')
items.dates_note: Final deadline Jan 21, 2027; notification Feb 18, 2027 (FilmFreeway snippet).
items.entry_fee: The snippets disagree: one lists $39-54 earlybird and $49-69 regular depending on category; another lists $10 earlybird rising to $30. Check FilmFreeway.
items.requirements: Submit through FilmFreeway. Categories include Best AI Film, Best AI Short Film and Best AI Feature Film.
items.prize: Awards and laurels; no cash prizes confirmed in the snippets.
items.fit: A dedicated AI-cinema festival with a short-film category: a straightforward laurel for Matter of Light.

items.name: Ai Film Festival (FilmFreeway listing 'AifilmFestival')
items.organizer: Ai Film Festival (independent; may be related to aifilmfest.org, not confirmed)
items.dates_note: Listed deadlines include Nov 19, 2026 and Dec 17, 2026; finalists screen at the festival's screening event in March 2027.
items.requirements: Films 1-10 minutes.
items.prize: Finalists are screened; no prize details in the snippets.
items.fit: The 6-minute short fits the 1-10 minute window, and entry is cheap and quick.

items.name: AI Artist Festival
items.dates_note: Final deadline Dec 5, 2026; festival Dec 26-27, 2026.
items.requirements: AI-generated short and feature films.
items.prize: Not stated in snippets
items.fit: A quick AI-specific laurel with a December screening; worth it if the fee is small.

items.name: AI SLOP Film Festival
items.dates_note: Final deadline Dec 16, 2026; notification Dec 23, 2026; event Jan 23, 2027.
items.requirements: Projects must meaningfully involve AI tools. All genres (narrative, experimental, animation, documentary, meme-based); no strict runtime limit.
items.prize: Category awards: Best AI Film, Best Generative Short, Slop of the Year, Audience Signal Award (no cash stated).
items.fit: A cheap AI showcase, but its tongue-in-cheek 'slop' branding may clash with a serious cinematic fantasy brand.

items.name: Hong Kong AI International Film Festival (HKAIIFF) 2027
items.organizer: Hong Kong AI International Film Festival
items.dates_note: 2027 entries opened in late Sept 2026 and close Mar 1, 2027, 11:59 pm Hong Kong time. Seven redesigned awards (replacing 19), including the Golden Unicorn Grand Prix and Narrative, Audiovisual and Experiential Innovation awards.
items.entry_fee: $99 per work (no extra charge per award)
items.requirements: Open to individuals, teams, studios and schools. The submitted version must be completed on or after Aug 1, 2026. It must be a complete, assessable work (no trailers or pitches), and you must explain the significant human decisions.
items.prize: Golden Unicorn Grand Prix plus six other awards (cash amounts not stated in snippets).
items.fit: Episode 2 (finished after Aug 1, 2026) qualifies; Matter of Light qualifies only if a new cut is completed after that date.

items.name: WAIFF - World AI Film Festival (Cannes Grand Finale 2027 and regional editions)
items.organizer: WAIFF (France); regional editions including WAIFF LA USA and Abidjan
items.dates_note: Grand Finale Apr 6-7, 2027 at the Palais des Festivals, Cannes; about 12 regional editions feed it. The site says submissions are open, but exact 2027 deadlines were not visible in the snippets.
items.entry_fee: WAIFF USA on FilmFreeway: live-action short earlybird $30 standard / $15 student; feature $35 / $20; later tiers cost more. Fees for the Cannes edition itself were not seen.
items.requirements: A production file explaining the AI tools used is required; selection favours work where AI plays a meaningful creative role. USA categories include Live Action Short, Animated Short, Music Video, Vertical/Mobile, Commercial, XR and Gaming; WAIFF also accepts screenplays and AI film music.
items.prize: Screening in a dedicated AI competition at the Palais des Festivals, Cannes, plus awards (cash not stated in snippets).
items.fit: The Palais screening is the biggest-screen AI showcase. Strong target for Matter of Light with a production file, and it has a music-video and film-music lane for the Suno songs.

items.name: Seoul International AI Film Festival
items.organizer: Seoul International AI Film Festival (FilmFreeway listing)
items.dates_note: Deadlines: Nov 30, 2026; Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31 and Apr 30, 2027. Notification May 5, 2027; event May 30-31, 2027.
items.requirements: Categories include AI Film, AI Movie Director and Film Poster.
items.prize: Awards (no cash stated)
items.fit: A low-cost Korean AI laurel, and the key art could go in Film Poster. Check its standing first: it is a FilmFreeway-only, many-deadline awards format.

items.name: Busan International AI Film Festival (BIAIF)
items.dates_note: 2026 festival runs Dec 3-5, 2026 at Busan Cinema Center. The 2026 submission deadline was not found and has probably passed.
items.requirements: AI used partly or fully, with a description of the AI technology. Film produced after Sept 2025; any genre; one entry per person or group; submit via the BIAIF site or FilmFreeway with an online screener link.
items.prize: Each selected film gets a USD 1,000 screening grant; the Audience Award adds USD 3,000.
items.fit: A screening grant just for being selected is rare. Check whether Matter of Light was produced after Sept 2025; otherwise aim Episode 2 at the 2027 edition.

items.name: AI Film Award 2027 (1 Billion Followers Summit, Dubai)
items.organizer: 1 Billion Followers Summit, Dubai (2027 edition powered by Seedance)
items.dates_note: Submit by Nov 20, 2026; five finalists announced Dec 15, 2026; premiere and grand-prize announcement Jan 8-10, 2027 in Dubai. (The 2026 edition was powered by Google Gemini, ran 7-10 min, and drew 3,500 entries.)
items.requirements: An original, complete 5-7 min film 'powered by Seedance' (a tool requirement); age 18+; one film per person. Scoring out of 100: AI Integration 30%, Storytelling 30%, Creativity & Aesthetic 20%, Technical Execution 20%.
items.prize: $1,000,000 grand prize
items.fit: The 6-minute runtime fits exactly, but the film must be made with Seedance (a single-tool requirement), so it only works if Episode 2 or a recut is built in Seedance.

items.name: Astana AI Film Festival (AAIFF)
items.dates_note: 2026: call opened April 2026; deadline Aug 15, extended to Aug 31; festival Oct 1-3, 2026 (8,000+ films from 125 countries). No 2027 call yet.
items.requirements: 2026 had a thematic competition and an open competition (character, direction, visual, story, concept).
items.prize: 2026: $2M fund, split into $1M prizes (thematic grand prize $450,000, then $200,000 and $100,000; five $50,000 open-category awards) and $1M invested in new AI productions.
items.fit: Free entry, huge cash and production investment: the single most important AI-festival call to watch for 2027.

items.name: AI for Good Film Festival 2027
items.dates_note: Submissions Jan 15-May 1, 2027; selection from May 16; finalists announced May 24; screening and reception at the AI for Good Global Summit, Geneva, week of Jun 21-25, 2027.
items.entry_fee: Reported free in an aggregator snippet; not confirmed on the official page
items.requirements: 1-10 min film where AI is central to the filmmaking; rights cleared; AI use described transparently.
items.prize: Finalist screening and reception at the UN summit in Geneva (2026 named 1st-3rd place winners).
items.fit: The runtime fits, but the theme leans toward social good, so pitch the story's light-versus-darkness hope angle.

items.name: Curious Refuge x Epidemic Sound AI Horror Film Competition 2026
items.dates_note: Closes Oct 9, 2026, 11:59 pm Pacific; audience voting Oct 21-28; winners announced Oct 29.
items.entry_fee: Free (Curious Refuge describes its competitions as free entry)
items.requirements: AI in every shot, with a majority of AI-generated pixels; max 3 min; music and SFX must come from Epidemic Sound (no Suno score); original idea with no third-party IP (your own world is fine); required end card.
items.prize: $12,000 cash: $7,000 / $3,000 / $2,000, plus a free Curious Refuge course, a shout-out and a sweatshirt; separate audience favourite.
items.fit: A 3-minute dark-fantasy horror vignette set in Litiguh can be done in three days, but the music must be Epidemic Sound, not your Suno tracks.

items.name: Curious Refuge seasonal AI film competitions (Feel Good, Animation, Comedy, Holiday)
items.dates_note: Themed contests run year-round; for example, the 2026 Feel Good competition closed Mar 10 with $10,000 cash. The events page also lists outside AI festivals.
items.requirements: Themed, short runtimes, sponsor-specific rules (often a required music library or tool).
items.prize: Typical pools of $10,000-$12,000 cash plus course enrollment
items.fit: Reliable free targets every few months for short AI pieces from the Stone of Matter world.

items.name: Berlin AI Film Festival
items.dates_note: Deadlines: Mar 31 (earlybird), May 31 (regular), Jul 31 (late), Dec 31, 2026 (extended).
items.requirements: AI films via FilmFreeway.
items.prize: Festival-strategy counselling from NewBorn Short Film Agency (valued at $1,500); iPitch.tv subscriptions ($189 12-month; $117 3-month special mention).
items.fit: The prize is professional festival-strategy advice, which is useful for planning Matter of Light's festival run.

items.name: AI Filmfestival (Germany's first AI film festival)
items.dates_note: Early-bird deadline was Jun 30, 2026; later deadlines and event dates were not in the snippets.
items.requirements: AI films; categories include Best AI Film, Documentary, AI-Supported Diversity Film and Rookie.
items.prize: EUR 2,000 Best AI Film; EUR 1,000 Best AI Documentary; EUR 1,000 Best AI-Supported Diversity Film; EUR 500 Best AI Rookie.
items.fit: Real cash for Best AI Film at a low fee; check whether a later deadline is still open.

items.name: Tribeca Festival 2027 - Shorts and Music Videos
items.dates_note: Shorts and music videos: early Oct 28, 2026; official Dec 2, 2026; extended Feb 3, 2027. 2027 submissions are open across features, shorts and music videos, TV, digital creators, games, podcasts and Tribeca X.
items.entry_fee: Not shown in snippets (fees rise at each deadline)
items.requirements: Submit through the Tribeca portal. No AI rule for 2027 shorts was found, but Tribeca has programmed AI work (Sora Shorts in 2024, the AI feature 'Dreams of Violet'; NoFilmSchool: 'Tribeca is allowing AI-made shorts to compete'). Its separate Love & Laughs program bans generative AI. Read the 2027 rules and premiere requirements.
items.prize: Selection and NYC screening; juried awards (amounts not in snippets).
items.fit: The most prestigious US festival that has openly screened AI shorts: submit the short and a Suno music video by the Oct 28 early deadline.

items.name: Lumen Prize for Art & Technology
items.dates_note: The 2026 call ran Jan 26-May 23, 2026, with grace to May 27. A 2027 call is not announced yet; a similar winter-spring window is likely but not confirmed.
items.requirements: Technology-driven art, explicitly including AI art, generative art and experimental moving image.
items.prize: 2026: three category prizes of $5,000 each plus a $15,000 Gold Award ($30,000 total).
items.fit: An art-and-tech prize that explicitly welcomes AI moving image; a striking excerpt or the full short could compete.

items.name: Prix Ars Electronica 2027 - New Animation Art
items.dates_note: Submissions open in Jan 2027 with a deadline in March 2027 (exact date to be announced); festival in Linz Sep 8-12, 2027.
items.requirements: Experimental work at the meeting point of animation, art and technology, created or significantly updated within the last two years.
items.prize: Golden Nica and prize money of up to EUR 10,000 per category.
items.fit: A prestigious media-art prize where AI-driven animation is in scope; strongest if you present the AI pipeline as an artistic method.

items.name: AI ZONE International AI Film Festival 2026
items.dates_note: Listed as a global online festival running Jun 1-Dec 31, 2026; exact submission cut-off not in snippets.
items.requirements: AI-generated cinema only: narrative shorts, experimental work, animation, music videos, abstract visuals.
items.prize: Not stated in snippets
items.fit: Takes both shorts and music videos: an easy online laurel for the film and a Suno video.

items.name: Global AI Music Video Awards (GAIMVA)
items.dates_note: Early Jul 10, standard Sep 1, late Jan 1, 2027; awards event Apr 24, 2027.
items.requirements: Fully AI-generated, AI-assisted or hybrid music videos; open to musicians, directors, AI creators, students and studios.
items.prize: $1,000 total cash
items.fit: Made for a Suno soundtrack song set to Litiguh visuals.

items.name: AI International Music Video Festival
items.organizer: AI International Music Video Festival (FilmFreeway listing; Hollywood screenings)
items.dates_note: 13th show Sun Oct 18, 2026 at the Los Angeles Performing Arts Conservatory, Hollywood; October submissions are considered for the December 2026 Hollywood show (recurring screening cycles).
items.requirements: AI music videos.
items.prize: Hollywood screening
items.fit: Regular Hollywood screenings for an AI music video of a soundtrack track, with a fast turnaround.

items.name: AI Song Contest
items.organizer: AI Song Contest (international; 2026 award show in Bangkok)
items.dates_note: 2026 submissions closed Sep 27, 2026 (AoE); award show in Bangkok Nov 29, 2026. Watch for the 2027 call.
items.requirements: AI must be used and the process described, but prompt-only, unedited fully generated outputs are automatically disqualified. Max 4 min; deliver the audio file, form, team imagery and a process write-up.
items.prize: $1,000 cash plus a trip to the award ceremony
items.fit: Good for 2027 if you write the lyrics yourself and edit or rearrange Suno stems; a raw Suno render would be disqualified.

items.name: Reply AI Music Contest
items.dates_note: 2026 call closed Jun 2 (extended); finalists performed at Kappa FuturFestival, Turin, Jul 3-5, 2026. No 2027 dates yet.
items.requirements: Focused on AI-based live music performance by producers and creators.
items.prize: At least 5 finalists invited to perform at Kappa FuturFestival with 3-day passes.
items.fit: A weak fit unless you can turn the soundtrack into a live audiovisual set; keep it on the watch list.

items.name: Suno Collabs remix contests
items.dates_note: Rolling contests. From the snippets: 'WATERFALL (Eclipse Mix)' by POLINA takes submissions Oct 1-15 (judging to Oct 29); 'Take Me Back' by Braylon Browner ran Sep 25-Oct 9; ADE 2026 x Todd Terry winners due Oct 9. The 'Trick or Treat' Halloween remix (Oct 17-27) and the Holiday Remix (due before Dec 26) pages may be from earlier years; their year was not confirmed.
items.requirements: Remix the featured track in Suno and submit on the collab page.
items.prize: Typically a Suno Premier plan and extra credits for top remixes; some contests advertise $5K+ prize pools.
items.fit: Quick, frequent practice that builds your Suno profile; low reward for a few hours of effort.

items.name: SSC - SongContest.AI
items.organizer: Community-run; founded by Finnish creator Ville 'Wappie' Pesonen
items.dates_note: Seasonal, with one two-week submission window per season and rounds of Campfires, Semifinals and Finals with listening parties. Next window not found.
items.requirements: One entry per person; PG-13; no political or religious content; only participants vote (no self-voting or campaigning).
